metadata.title: RESONATE tutorial sample data: MERFISH human fetal heart subsample with matched scRNA-seq reference and scGPT-spatial gene embeddings
metadata.description:
Small sample data (about 12 MB) for the tutorial of the RESONATE software (https://github.com/J041120h/RESONATE), which predicts genes never measured in a spatial transcriptomics panel from a matched single-cell reference and gene embeddings.

Contents: (1) a 12,000-cell spatial window of a 13 PCW human fetal heart MERFISH section (236-gene panel; raw counts, authors' cell-type annotation); (2) a stratified 8,011-cell subsample of the matched scRNA-seq reference restricted to 2,244 genes; (3) the matching rows of the scGPT-spatial token-embedding table; (4) the list of 48 held-out genes used in the tutorial benchmark. Spatial data and reference derive from Farah et al., Nature 2024 (Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.w0vt4b8vp, Zenodo 10420367, CC0 1.0); embeddings derive from scGPT-spatial V1 (figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.28356068, CC BY 4.0).
